notes.title: 3rd Update, May 21st & Sale
notes.content:
[b] HAROLD NOW $8.99(US) FOR A VERY LIMITED TIME!	[/b]

Greetings Guardians! 

We have just released our 3rd update for Harold! And in celebration we've also put it on sale!

With this patch, we're taking the first step in bringing the competition feel of Harold to the forefront.

Changes Made : 
[list]
    [*]Leadboard now accessible directly from Level Selection screen! No longer will you have to actually complete a race to be able to see the leaderboards in game. You can now just scroll to the race you want to check and select the leaderboard option from the menu screen!
    [*]There are now 2 separate leaderboards per race; One for those have found and taken the shortcuts and another for those whom haven't. This split was done for the hardcore guardians who want to speed run and compete without the need of a shortcut and still be able to compare times to others. Also, if you've been wondering how your friends or other guardians have gotten some of their times, you can now see if the shortcut in each race had any role to play in the matter. 
[/list]
We Hope you enjoy these new features. We are preparing for a Harold Competition so get to practicing Guardians! 

Farewell Guardians!

notes.title: 3/19/2015 Update
notes.content:
Greetings Guardians!

We have just released our 2nd update for Harold!

After listening to all the feedback from all over, we are here to announce to you all of the new features in this update!

Changes Made :
[list]
    [*]New Gamepad configurations! Now select between 3 gamepad configs. Type A, B, & C.
    [*]Vsync! for those of you with powerful gfx cards, you can now lock your FPS at 60 to eliminate tearing effects!
    [*]Antialiasing! You can now set AA to 2X, 4X, 8X or off in the options menu!
 [*]Anisotropic Filtering! Toggleable in the options menu!
 [*]Windowed Mode! Toggleable in the options menu!
 [*]Master Volume Control! You can now control the master volume in the options menu!
 [*]Cycle Obstacles Option! With this option on, you'll cycle back to the first obstacle in the list when pressing the next obstacle button on the last obstacle and vice versa when pressing previous. you can toggle this feature on or off in the options menu!
 [*]Bug Fixes! Several pesky minor bugs have been squashed.
[/list]

We Hope you enjoy these new features. Our next update will focus on improving the competetive feel of the game. But more on that later!

Farewell Guardians!

notes.title: Upcoming Features!
notes.content:
Greetings Guardians!

We've been reading the discussion boards and reviews and hearing all your feedback. Thank you all so much! With that being said, we are working hard to get some of these imporvements out to y'all as soon as possible.

Here's a list some of  the things we've got in the pipeline!
[list]
    [*]Video Options! We've noticed that many of you have asked for more control in your resolutions and other video settings. We'll be adding these requests in. e.g. Resolution Sizes, Antialiasing, Anisotropic, Vysync, & Windowed Mode!
    [*]Leaderboards showing who's taken the shortcuts and who hasn't!
    [*]Displaying the Leaderboards in the race menu! No more needing to bring up the overlay to see them or waiting till the end of the race!
    [*]Obstacles Selection Cycling!
    [*]Multiple Gamepad Button Configurations!
    [*]Master Volume Controls!
[/list]
We'll continue announcing any new things to come and continue to pay attention to all feedback being given. Thank you Guardians and have fun!

notes.title: First Update for Harold Now !
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

We are very excited to annouce the first patch notes for Harold. :)

We'd like to thank all of you who provided feedback,it has been very helpfull !

We will continue improving this game for you guys ;)

Without further ado, the patch note :
[list]
    [*]Instant reset ( Back/Select Button ) works now in pratice mode too !
    [*]Walls and stalactites control bugs fixed.
    [*]Various minor other bugs fixed ( such as collision issues ).
[/list]
